title: Commander Advice Unit Manifest
description: One conceptual unit of infrastructure's manifest: every CA on that unit, in one cheap read. Every unit shares this same kind regardless of the unit's own name, since the unit name is already the sub-directory and the file name; the global manifest at commander/advice/MANIFEST-advice.json reads every unit manifest in turn. Named MANIFEST-<unit>.json.

kind.description: the words commander-advice-unit, which is what chooses this schema and is the same for every unit manifest

unit.description: the conceptual unit of infrastructure this manifest covers, matching the sub-directory it sits in and the unit field of every CA it lists

version.description: a number bumped when the unit's manifest shape changes, so a reader can tell an old copy from a new one

updated.description: the date the manifest was last brought level with its CA files, YYYY-MM-DD

convention.description: one line on what this unit covers and how it is kept, for a reader who has never opened it

units.description: one row per CA on this unit

items.description: one CA: its id, a plain-language summary, and the path to open it

id.description: the CA's identifier, CA, a dash and three digits

name.description: one to three words the writer chose for the record's contents, appended to the file name after the id (CA-049)

date.description: the day the commander gave it, YYYY-MM-DD

status.description: active while it shapes the unit, retired once no longer relevant

summary.description: a plain-language summary of the whole advice item, enough to decide whether to open it

path.description: where the CA file sits, relative to this manifest

superseded_by.description: the identifier of the later advice item that overrides this one, for a row kept so the record is complete
